title: Bundle third-party licenses and notices in Phoenix distributions
outcome: Every Phoenix binary distribution includes accurate first-party terms and the required third-party license and notice material.
acceptance: A decisive automated contract test fails when required license or notice payloads are missing from publish output.
A generated or maintained third-party notice inventory covers the exact production NuGet closure, the platform .NET runtime payload, MCP C# SDK notices, and SQLitePCLRaw NOTICE content.
Self-contained and framework-dependent publish outputs contain the applicable Phoenix license or use terms plus third-party notices.

completion.summary: Bundled PhoenixCodeNav Apache-2.0 licensing, exact third-party notices, runtime-pack legal files, and decisive source/publish contract tests.
